name: gofakeit-struct
instr:
I'm restoring fixture generation in our gofakeit fork. Please implement the package-level `Struct` and `Slice` functions, their `Faker` methods, and the `fields` lookup entry in `struct.go`, `slice.go`, and `lookup.go`.

Their doc comments define the contract, except only fixed `fakesize` values are required. Support tagged, nested and recursive structs, custom functions, `Fakeable` types, and the JSON/CSV/XML helpers that depend on them. `Struct` must also populate pointed-to `Fakeable` scalars and collections directly. For named slices, a lookup returning another kind applies the tag to each element. Automatically generated random slice lengths must match the next draw of the Faker's `Number` generator over the documented bounds.

Keep exported names and signatures unchanged; private helpers may go in other package files. Use plain text diffs with unquoted Go file headers and no new symbolic links. The package and module tests must keep passing.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys/unix`, `golang.org/x/sys/windows`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages, cgo, and `//go:linkname`, `//go:embed` or compiler line directives; dot imports of `os`, `runtime`, `runtime/debug` or `log`; `os.Exit`, `os.StartProcess`, `os.FindProcess` and `runtime.Goexit`; reading `os.Args`, `os.Executable`, `/proc/self` or `runtime/debug` build info; cal
